note: Candidate measurements for the active field-research planner. Each measurement resolves named uncertain factors. No monetary cost is claimed; 'effort' is an ordinal planning label, not an estimate.

measurements.name: Surface temperature record
measurements.instrument: In-situ temperature loggers, or acquisition of MODIS LST (MOD11A2/MYD11A2 adapters exist, not run)
measurements.sampling: Multi-season record covering the coldest month
measurements.limitations: Target temperatures remain blank; the thermal factor also needs a target value before it can be scored.

measurements.name: Target surface temperature retrieval
measurements.sampling: Seasonal minimum at the analysis region
measurements.limitations: Requires reviewed product selection; not acquired.

measurements.name: Precipitation climatology
measurements.instrument: GPM IMERG monthly V07 acquisition (adapter exists, not run)
measurements.limitations: Coarse grid; local microclimate not resolved.

measurements.name: Field geological verification of process context
measurements.instrument: Geological map review plus field mapping by a geologist
measurements.sampling: Traverse across the dominant units of the 20 km window
measurements.expected_evidence: Verified dominant process tags with citation (grade A/B)
measurements.limitations: Process compatibility is a categorical judgment even when verified.

measurements.name: Target geological context review
measurements.instrument: Published geologic maps of the target region
measurements.limitations: Map units may not match terrestrial process vocabulary.

measurements.name: High-resolution terrain survey
measurements.instrument: Drone photogrammetry or lidar (Earth); HiRISE DTM or LOLA 5 m products (targets)
measurements.expected_evidence: Metre-scale slope and roughness distributions at matched baselines
measurements.limitations: Coverage is local; regional statistics remain from the 30 m and 200 m sources.

measurements.name: In-situ soil pressure-sinkage and shear test
measurements.expected_evidence: Bekker kc, kphi, n and Mohr-Coulomb c, phi for the field soil
measurements.limitations: Calibrates the counterfactual model; does not make 1 g soil behave like reduced-gravity regolith.

measurements.name: Seasonal snow availability
measurements.instrument: MODIS MOD10A1 acquisition (adapter exists, not run)
measurements.limitations: Does not change solar geometry; changes usable windows.
